hero_eyebrow: Born in the Maluti Highlands, Lesotho

lookbook.caption: One of us, wherever you are

story_paragraph_1: Hope Hub started as one name, said differently. Ts'epo. "Hope is the fundametal essence of life. Take it away, and even the strongest collapse... Give a person nothing but hope, and somehow they build. It is the only thing we inherit that grows heavier and more necessary the longer we carry it and the only debt worth passing on to the next generation. Ka lehlohonolo its in my name" ~Ts'epo Mantutle
story_paragraph_2: "Same reason we print the boy who looked beyond the village, hope isn't what you find out there. It's what you refuse to put down on the way."
hero_sub: Luxury streetwear cut for the mountain kingdom heavy cotton, hand-finished pieces, made in small runs for those who carry it forward.
delivery_policy: Delivery: around town every Saturday via Maseru Jays. Collection: pick up any weekday at Foso Hardware, Ha Foso. Fit & exchanges: not quite right? Say so at the meetup or delivery and we'll sort a size swap on the spot.
